description: Planner UI: create all planner pages and components (TermForm, AddTopicModal, Planner, PlannerTerm, PlannerSubject). Depends on FEAT-001 for db/planner.js functions. Independent of FEAT-003 (nav updates).
steps: Create src/components/planner/TermForm.jsx. Named export TermForm. Props: { initialValues, onSubmit, onCancel }. Controlled form with fields: name (text input), year (text input, placeholder '2026/2027'), termNumber (select 1/2/3), startDate (date input), endDate (date input). Uses Button from '../../components/ui/Button' with variant='primary' for submit and variant='secondary' for cancel. Apply design tokens: labels text-sm text-ink-soft, inputs border border-line rounded-xl bg-paper px-3 py-2 w-full text-ink.

Create src/components/planner/AddTopicModal.jsx. Named export AddTopicModal. Props: { subjectName, curriculumSubjectId, curriculumClassId, onAdd, onClose }. Import curriculumMap from '../../data/curriculumData'. When curriculumSubjectId and curriculumClassId are set and curriculumMap[curriculumSubjectId]?.[curriculumClassId] exists: render a 3-step picker — (1) strand select pills (same pattern as Curriculum.jsx strand tabs), (2) sub-strand accordion (same pattern as StandardCard in Curriculum.jsx but selectable), (3) content standard select with checkboxes for indicators. Also render a notes textarea. 'Add Topic' button calls onAdd({ strandId, subStrandId, contentStandardId, indicatorIds: string[], notes }). When no curriculum data: show only a notes textarea with 'Add Note' button calling onAdd({ strandId:null, subStrandId:null, contentStandardId:null, indicatorIds:[], notes }). Modal overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center. Panel: bg-card rounded-xl p-5 max-w-sm w-full mx-4 max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto. Close button (X) in top-right calls onClose.

Create src/pages/Planner.jsx. Default export Planner. Import useLiveQuery from 'dexie-react-hooks', { createTerm, updateTerm, deleteTerm } from '../db/planner', { db } from '../db/database', TermForm from '../components/planner/TermForm'. Use useLiveQuery(() => db.terms.orderBy('createdAt').reverse().toArray(), []) for the terms list. State: showCreate (bool), editingTerm (term|null). Empty state: centered illustration text + '+ Create Term' Button. Term list: each term in a Card-like div (border border-line rounded-xl bg-card p-4 mb-3) showing term name (font-semibold), year badge (rounded-full bg-accent/10 text-accent text-xs px-2), 'Term N' label, date range (text-sm text-ink-soft), edit pencil icon + trash icon buttons, ChevronRight icon linking to /planner/:termId via useNavigate. Modals use TermForm. Delete calls window.confirm then deleteTerm(id). Page header: CalendarDays icon + 'Lesson Planner' h1 + subtitle. pb-24 on outer div.

Create src/pages/PlannerTerm.jsx. Default export PlannerTerm. Import useParams, useNavigate, useLiveQuery, db, addClassGroup, removeClassGroup, addSubject, removeSubject from respective modules. Load term via useLiveQuery(() => db.terms.get(Number(termId))). Load classGroups via useLiveQuery(() => db.classGroups.where('termId').equals(Number(termId)).toArray()). For each classGroup load subjects via useLiveQuery (or load all subjects once: db.subjects.where('classGroupId').anyOf(classGroupIds).toArray()). State: showAddClass (bool), addSubjectForGroup (classGroupId|null), classLevelInput, subjectNameInput, subjectCurriculumSubjectId, subjectCurriculumClassId. Class level select: Basic 1 through Basic 9 (B1–B9). Add class group: addClassGroup(termId, selectedLevel). Remove class group: confirm then removeClassGroup(id). Add subject modal: name text + optional curriculum link dropdowns (subject select from curriculumData.subjects, class select from curriculumData.classes filtered to those with data for selected subject). Remove subject: confirm then removeSubject(id). Each subject card links to /planner/${termId}/${subject.id} with ChevronRight. Back link to /planner. pb-24 on outer div.

Create src/pages/PlannerSubject.jsx. Default export PlannerSubject. Import useParams, useLiveQuery, db, upsertWeekPlan, addWeekTopic, removeWeekTopic from respective modules. Import AddTopicModal from '../components/planner/AddTopicModal'. Load subject via db.subjects.get(Number(subjectId)). Load weekPlans via db.weekPlans.where('subjectId').equals(Number(subjectId)).toArray() — build a map weekPlanByWeekNumber keyed by weekNumber. Load weekTopics by collecting all weekPlan ids then db.weekTopics.where('weekPlanId').anyOf(planIds).toArray() — build a map topicsByPlanId. Render 16 week rows (weeks 1–16) as a vertical list. Each row is a section with border border-line rounded-xl bg-card mb-3 p-4. Row shows: 'Week N' label (font-semibold), weekType select (teaching/revision/exam/vacation) — onChange calls upsertWeekPlan(subjectId, weekNum, {weekType:val, status: existing?.status||'planned', updatedAt:Date.now()}); status select for teaching weeks only (planned/taught/skipped) — onChange calls upsertWeekPlan similarly. Topics list beneath (if weekPlan exists): each topic shows contentStandard code from curriculumMap lookup (or note preview), × remove button calling removeWeekTopic(id). '+ Add Topic' button opens AddTopicModal with onAdd = async (topicData) => { const plan = await upsertWeekPlan(...); await addWeekTopic(plan.id, topicData); closeModal(); }. Back link to /planner/:termId. pb-24 on outer div.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors after all 5 files are created
Planner.jsx renders a terms list using useLiveQuery and opens TermForm in a modal
PlannerTerm.jsx renders class groups and subjects, with add/remove modals for each
PlannerSubject.jsx renders 16 week rows with type/status selects and topic management
AddTopicModal shows curriculum picker when curriculumSubjectId+curriculumClassId are set, plain textarea otherwise
TermForm is reusable across create and edit flows
findings: All 5 files created and build passes (1733 modules, built in ~11s). TermForm: controlled form with all required fields. AddTopicModal: 3-step curriculum picker (strand pills → sub-strand accordion → content standard + indicator checkboxes) plus notes textarea; falls back to notes-only when no curriculum data. Planner: live terms list with create/edit/delete modals. PlannerTerm: class groups with per-group subject lists, add/remove modals for both, curriculum linking optional. PlannerSubject: 16 week rows with weekType + status selects, topic list with remove, AddTopicModal integration. upsertWeekPlan called correctly for both type and status changes. Routing registration deferred to FEAT-003 as specified.
